lines.en: Somewhere...in a far-off, distant land...
The war rages on...
Previously, on the Battle for Kumon-mi...
Ayane Amamiya of the famed Amamiya dynasty made her run at a lifelong adversary in hopes of reclaiming the land that was rightfully given to her at birth.
But after a long and painstaking series of setbacks, it finally set in that this battle might not be as easy as she originally thought!
With a fire in her heart and the determination to finish out the fight and reclaim her holy land, will she be able to summon the strength needed to defeat her arch-nemesis?!
Or will that nemesis simply be too powerful for her to overcome?
The leader of the Arakawa clan has no intention of giving up the land he has worked so hard to refine and reconstruct over the course of his anguish-filled life!
Can one battle truly decide the fate of everything he loves?!
Can one battle turn the tide and restore the land to its original state, long before the endless wars and all of the lives lost?!
Two hearts become one!
Two lost souls with nothing but regret and heavy expectations on their shoulders must set aside their love for one another to fight for the greater good!
Who will win?!
: I will...
: I will.
The following program is brought to you in part by Koi Cafe! Home of the [[copyrighted frozen beverage]!
Long day? Short night? Come to Koi Cafe and try our specialty handcrafted drinks made by adorable girls!
We will now return to our regularly scheduled programming.
Please enjoy the show!
Pluuuuus...EXTRA!
: You haven’t learned a thing, have you?
: You’d think that after our last battle ended in a near-truce, you’d be a lot more welcoming today...father.
: That’s right. I am your father. This was a necessary plot development.
: I didn’t want you to find out like this, but I suppose it needed to happen eventually.
: So what do you say, Ayane?
: Will you join forces with me and rule this land in the name of the Arakawas?
: Or will you resign yourself to the cowardly Amamiyas? The same family who raised you and never told you of my existence...
: They only hid you from me because they knew it would hurt!
: But what hurts even more is knowing we are in love!
: Which I am totally okay with, by the way, but other people will probably think it’s weird!
: Yes! Tap into those feelings!
: Use them to become stronger, sudden-daughter of mine!
: If the two of us join forces, we’ll be able to activate the hidden Arakawa-technique! The one that can only be used when father and daughter are united!
: The hidden Arakawa-technique?! Do you mean the ultra-hyper-mega-drive-flame-tornado wheel-dropkick-of-unity?!
: Heh...I guess the technique wasn’t as hidden as I thought, was it?
: Tch!
: Is it really okay for me to abandon the parents who raised me in order to reunite with my biological father? Especially when both of them are dying from an unidentified disease?
: Unidentified, you say?
: Well that’s just simply not true.
: In fact, I’m the one who created the disease that’s destroying their bodies as we speak.
: And what’s even better-
: Is that they only have three weeks left to live!
: Only three weeks?!
: How could you do this, father?!
: It’s one thing to abandon me by floating my body down the river-of-lost-hope, but to create a life-threatening disease in order to kill my adoptive parents?!
: That’s simply too much!
: Funny. Some say “too much” while others say “not enough.”
: Frankly, I thought about killing them much longer ago.
: But six years ago, after I saw you training with a wooden sword next to your above-ground pool in the backyard, I decided I couldn’t.
: That was you?!
: That was me.
: And to think that all of this time I’d been hoping to meet that man...
: Never did I once expect him to be the leader of the Arakawa clan who is also coincidentally my father and the man who poisoned my non-biological parents.
: And that’s not all...
: It’s not?!
: How much more convoluted can this get?!
: You see, [young]Amamiya. I am also...
: You from another timeline!!!!111111111
: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!!!!!!!!111111
: I’m my own dad!!!!
: And I killed my parents!
: Well, almost!
: This means that the only way to prevent their demise is to take back Kumon-mi by going into the past and destroying my future self before I can create me.
: But how?
: I haven’t learned the ability to time travel yet.
: Wait...
: What about...him?
: Who are you talking about, exactly?
: This is a battle between father and daughter. And also father and self.
: And daughter and self.
: And Amamiya and Arakawa.
: It was...
: Until now.
: What do you mean by that?...
: We’re the only two people here.
: People, yes...But why not take a look behind you?
: Behind me? But what-
: BACAWK! (Prepare to be eliminated!)
: I-It...It can’t be!
: Todd! Attack!
: Todd?!
: You should be dead!
: Todd is immortal in this timeline!
: BACAWK! (I can never die!)
: I-Impossible!
: Little did you know, that girl who you saw training with her sword in the backyard was also an expert chicken-tamer!
: I didn’t even know that was a thing!
: So what’ll it be, Master Arakawa? Are you ready to concede to Todd, the only person who has ever bested you in battle?
: Or will you fight to the death, ultimately killing me in the process because we’re the same person?
: Or something.
: BACAWK! (Bow before me, mortal! It is I! Todd!)
: Can he...drain my energy?
: Oh? You’re feeling it already?
: And here I was thinking you were stronger than that.
: The only reason Todd is immortal is because he can consume the life essence of others by simply looking at them.
: So much...power...
: My legs are...getting weaker...
: I...don’t think I can stand much longer...
: Don’t worry. You won’t have to.
: Lucky for you, which basically means lucky for us, I’ve thought up a way to defeat you without killing you.
: Without...killing me?...
: But...how?
: Don’t worry about that, future-me.
: Just close your eyes and everything will be okay...
: AMAMIYA FAMILY HIDDEN-TECHNIQUE! THROW!
: Your hidden technique is “Throw?!”
: Pray to whichever god you believe in, Master Arakawa...
: Your time on this planet ends now...
: No...Not like this...
: Ouch.
: That actually kind of hurt.
And so the battle comes to a close!
Ayane Amamiya of the Amamiya clan was able to defeat her arch-nemesis, the future version of herself, alongside her trusted chicken-companion, Todd!
But even though the battle has been won...things do not end here.
What will happen next?! Has Ayane truly reclaimed the land of Kumon-mi?!
Or is there an even greater evil lurking somewhere in the shadows?...

PLUUUUUS...EXTRA!
: Well fought today, Sensei.
: I had no idea you were really me this entire time.
: But I guess it makes sense given how much the two of us have in common.
: Yeah, I figured you might like that part.
: Also, I had no idea you owned a chicken.
: Really? He follows me around all the time.
: Sometimes, I don’t even realize he’s there.
: He’s a good boy, though.
: Why did you name him Todd? Is he American?
: No, he’s a chicken. Idiot.
: It’s kind of sad that we might not be able to do stuff like this anymore soon, though...
: What do you mean? The dojo isn’t closing down, is it?
: I’m not sure, to be honest.
: I heard the instructor talking about how someone was looking into buying it.
: I don’t have any idea what would happen to it after that.
: Well I can’t imagine they’d buy a dojo to just make it...not a dojo anymore.
: Sounds like we’ll just have new management or something.
: I don’t think we’ll be impacted that much.
: Besides, couldn’t you just buy it if things really came to that? You’re rich.
: True. But just because I’m rich doesn’t mean I could buy an entire dojo without any problems.
: I can’t just put it on my credit card and my dad is the one with the actual bank-access and stuff.
: I’m pretty sure if I asked him to buy a dojo when we already have a nicer one on the premises, he'd say no.
: Good point.
: I don’t think we need to worry, though. I can’t imagine anything will happen to this place in the end.
: Hopefully you’re right. All of the times we’ve spent here have become really important memories to me.
: Seeing them taken away would be kind of devastating.
: Worse comes to worst, we just hang out at your house, I guess.
: Yeah...Let’s hope it doesn’t come to that, though.
Ayane and I remain in the dojo for another half hour or so, reminiscing about all of the times we’ve spent here over the last few months.
The reminiscing turns to something slightly more suggestive once she starts recollecting how far we've come since then.
But at least it got her mind off of the sudden potential for our normal hang-out spot to become a thing of the past.
I really hope that rumor doesn’t wind up actually being true.
I’m finally starting to get used to this...
Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!
